faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Munger District Attenders recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Munger District Attenders recruitment is 09 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Attenders post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 10th standard from a recognized board to be eligible for the Attenders post in Munger District.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Attenders position?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 42 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules for various categories.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Attenders post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 31 vacancies announced for the Attenders post in the Munger District recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their filled application forms to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for Munger District Attenders recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Munger District Attenders recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Attenders posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Attenders posts will be based on Registration Priority and an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary structure for the Attenders post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Attenders post will be as per Minimum Wages. Specific details can be found in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Munger District, which is munger.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Attenders post in Munger District is temporary.
